speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: The lesion is a 4-cm tender ulcerative area with a central necrotic base and purplish irregular borders; it is surrounded by pitting pedal edema and dilated tortuous veins. The skin biopsy shows neutrophilic infiltration without infection, consistent with pyoderma gangrenosum. The Complete Blood Count is Normal. Blood Glucose Level is Elevated. Skin Culture was not performed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyoderma Gangrenosum. The biopsy confirming neutrophilic infiltration without infection, combined with the clinical presentation of a painful, ulcerative lesion with purplish borders and pitting edema, is diagnostic. Given your elevated blood glucose, I also recommend an endocrinology consult to evaluate for underlying diabetes mellitus.
